description: Stage-2 fail-closed static safety and coarse structural-observability policy. It never selects SA0/SA1 and never modifies a netlist.

clock_signal.description: Clock nets and all combinational or hierarchical logic that can drive a sequential clock pin or a clock-gate output.

clock_control.description: Logic that can control whether a gated clock is enabled, including test overrides.

async_reset_set.description: Asynchronous reset/set nets and all combinational or hierarchical logic that can drive them.

direct_exclusions.description: Module-input sites are hierarchy-boundary branch locations rather than one locally driven stem. Constant sites are not functional candidates. All CLKBUF/CLKGATE outputs are excluded conservatively even when graph reachability does not prove that a particular synthesized buffer is on a clock path.

scan_test_handling.description: A net that also has functional consumers is retained but flagged when it touches scan pins. A net whose only non-boundary consumers are scan/test pins is excluded.

coarse_observability.description: A retained site must reach a functional sequential D pin or a top-level output without crossing a sequential Q boundary.
